messages.text: I live in zone 9 in America (Florida) do you have milkweed plants for the extreme heat?

Hi Kim,

Apologies for the very long delay getting back to you, this is well beyond our usual standard and we're working to do better.

For zone 9 in Florida, the good news is that several milkweed species handle heat well. Asclepias tuberosa (Butterfly milkweed) and Asclepias incarnata (Swamp milkweed) both do fine in warm climates and are well suited to your area.

We carry seeds for several species here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/products/milkweed-seeds

One thing worth knowing: we ship from Canada, so for live plants we'd run into phytosanitary restrictions at the US border. Seeds cross just fine though, and for zone 9 you'd be planting into ideal conditions.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
